messages.subject: Mining Executive | ESG, Stakeholder & External Affairs Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Alana,

Ivy & Gecko's executive-search work across mining and industrial leadership is closely aligned with my experience. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am exploring Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where mining performance must align with regulators, communities and strategic stakeholders. I am internationally mobile, with Saudi Arabia and the UAE as priority markets.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
